name: Representation: Polygon as GeoJSON
abstract: The polygon data type of the data-types register, represented in GeoJSON.
description:
The polygon data type of the data-types register, represented in GeoJSON.

## Definition

`https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/data-formats/representation/polygon-geojson` is a `df:Representation`, a `rim:RegisterItem` of the `df:representationItemClass` item class. It realizes (`rim:realizes`) the version `https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/data-types/data-type/polygon/v1` of the data-types register and points (`df:format`) to the format [GeoJSON](../../format/geojson/): a GeoJSON `Polygon` object (RFC 7946). In `bblock.json`, `isDescribedBy` names the data type block `data-types.data-type.polygon`. `hasFormat` names [`polygon-gml`](../polygon-gml/), which represents the same data type in another format.

## Schema

`df:jsonSchemaFragment` is a reference to `https://geojson.org/schema/Polygon.json`, published by [geojson/schema](https://github.com/geojson/schema). The schemas of https://github.com/geojson/schema are published without a version (the URL serves the latest build), are written in JSON Schema draft-07, and cannot check that linear rings are closed or follow the right-hand rule (RFC 7946, section 3.1.6).

## Requested by

No role requests it yet. Added on 2026-11-17 by decision of Gérald: every GeoJSON object type that geojson/schema publishes and that the data-types register defines has a GeoJSON representation (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection, Geometry, Feature, FeatureCollection). The register specification allows a representation for each object type a format's specification defines since that date.
